text: Draw a single young man with cropped white hair and a headband, wearing an open long-sleeved coat over a top, black gloves, dark pants, and tall knee-high boots. Leave room for a small copyright credit.

I want one lone guy as the focus, his short white hair held back by a headband. His coat hangs open over long sleeves, and he wears black gloves with matching black trousers tucked into knee boots. A tiny copyright line sits somewhere in the frame.
白髪短髪・ヘッドバンドの男子。羽織ったコートは前を開けて、黒手袋に黒パンツ、ニーハイブーツ。隅に作品名を小さく。
男の子ひとりだけ描いてほしいんだけど、白い短髪にヘッドバンドつけてて、コートは前開けたままで、黒い手袋と黒パンツ、膝丈のブーツって感じ。隅っこに作品名のロゴ入れといて。

Draw one girl with very long blonde hair and a hair ornament, held by a black hairband. She wears a white dress with puffy short sleeves, stands barefoot, and a small star symbol appears nearby. Add a twitter handle in a corner.

A solitary blonde girl whose hair falls extremely long, kept neat by a black hairband and a small ornament. Her white dress has puffy short sleeves with a delicate frill, she is barefoot, and a little star floats beside her. Tuck a twitter username into the artwork.
金髪ロング、超ロングの女の子。黒いヘアバンドと髪飾り、白いパフスリーブのドレス、裸足。星マークひとつとtwitter名添えて。
すごく髪の長い金髪の子をひとり描いてくれる?黒のカチューシャと髪飾りつけて、パフスリーブの白いワンピース、足は裸足で。横に星をちょこっと、あとtwitterのID入れといて。

Draw a chibi girl with short purple hair and yellow eyes, looking at the viewer. She wears a pleated plaid skirt and high-heeled boots as an official alternate outfit, with a hair ornament and a heart motif.

A chibi-proportioned girl gazes straight out at us, her short purple hair pinned with an ornament and her yellow eyes bright. She wears an official alternate costume: a plaid pleated skirt and high-heeled boots, with a little heart accenting the scene and her modest figure.
紫の短髪・黄色い目のちびキャラ、こっち見てる。プレッシュなチェックのプリーツスカートにハイヒールブーツ、公式別衣装。髪飾りとハートを添えて。
ちびっこ体型で紫ショートの子、黄色い瞳でこっち見てる感じにして。公式の別コスでさ、チェックのプリーツスカートにヒールのブーツ。髪飾りとハートもちょい足しで。
青髪短髪・青い目の女の子。前髪が目の間に。学校制服にネクタイ、ヘルメットと帽子、ネイル。銃を構えていて、背景は青。
青い髪を短く切った女の子、瞳も青くて前髪が目元にかかってる。制服に蝶結びのリボンとネクタイ、頭にはヘルメット、指先にはネイル。両手で銃をしっかり握り、背景は一面の青で。
Short blue-haired girl, blue eyes, bangs between her eyes. School uniform with a necktie, a helmet, painted nails, gripping a gun against a blue backdrop.

Can you do a girl with short blue hair and blue eyes, bangs falling between them? She's in a school uniform with a tie, wearing a helmet, nails done, and she's holding a gun ready. Just flood the background with blue.

Draw soccer players in sports uniforms, hair flaps and blunt bangs, one in a ponytail. Mix of brown, blue and pink hair, blue eyes, shirts in blue, yellow and orange. One covers her own mouth, face partly shaded. Add a date.

A scene of figures in soccer kit, sporty jerseys in blue, yellow and orange. Their hair varies—brown, blue, pink—with blunt bangs and stray hair flaps, one tied into a ponytail. Blue eyes throughout; one of them shyly covers her mouth as shadow falls across her face. Mark a small date somewhere.
サッカーのユニ姿。青・黄・オレンジのシャツ、茶髪に青髪・ピンク髪、ポニテの子も。青い目、ぱっつん前髪、顔に影。口元を手で隠す子と日付を。
サッカーの試合っぽい絵にしてほしいな。ユニフォームは青と黄色とオレンジで、髪色は茶・青・ピンクってバラバラ、ぱっつん前髪でポニテの子もいる。みんな青い目で、ひとり口を手で隠してて顔に影。隅に日付ちょこっと。
オレンジ短髪・青い目の男子ひとり。黒いノースリーブシャツにベルト付きパンツ、ヘッドホン。花とぬいぐるみを添えて、横を向いた構図で。
オレンジ色の短い髪で青い瞳の男の子をひとり。袖のない黒シャツにベルトを締めたパンツ、首にはヘッドホン。視線は横へそらしていて、傍らに花とぬいぐるみを置いた感じで描いて。
One boy, orange short hair, blue eyes, looking aside. Sleeveless black shirt, belted pants, headphones on. A flower and a stuffed toy nearby.

Give me a single guy with short orange hair and blue eyes glancing off to the side. He's got a sleeveless black shirt, pants with a belt, headphones around his neck—and toss in a flower and a little stuffed toy beside him.
金髪短髪のちび女の子ひとり。黒いサイハイは片方だけ、もう片方は黒ソックスとニーハイ。花柄、ブーツ、隣に動物。茶色背景に輪郭線。
デフォルメされた小さな金髪ショートの子をひとり。靴下は左右ちぐはぐで、片脚だけ黒いサイハイ、もう一方は黒ソックスとニーハイ。花柄の入った服にブーツ、足元には小さな動物。茶色一色の背景にくっきり輪郭線で。
Chibi blonde girl, short hair, solo. One black thighhigh on a single leg, black socks and kneehighs otherwise, boots, floral print. A little animal beside her, brown background, clean outline.

I'd love a tiny chibi version of a blonde short-haired girl, just her. Mismatched legwear—one black thighhigh, otherwise black socks and kneehighs—boots, floral pattern on her clothes. Pop a small animal next to her, brown backdrop, bold outlines.

Draw two girls together: one blonde, one brown-haired with a braid and a ponytail, an ahoge sticking up. Blue eyes, multicolored hair, white short-sleeved shirts showing collarbones, with a hair ribbon.

Two girls side by side. One has blonde hair, the other brown with a tidy braid pulled into a ponytail and a stray ahoge. Their hair shows several colors, eyes are blue, and they wear white short-sleeved shirts that bare their collarbones, one tied off with a hair ribbon.
女の子ふたり。片方金髪、片方は茶髪で三つ編みとポニテ、アホ毛。青い目、多色の髪、鎖骨見える白い半袖シャツ、髪リボン。
女子ふたり並べて描いてほしい。ひとりは金髪、もうひとりは茶髪で三つ編みをポニーテールにして、アホ毛ぴょこん。どっちも青い目で髪は何色か混ざってて、白い半袖シャツから鎖骨が見えてる、髪リボンも。
Draw a single clothed Pokemon with blue eyes and a tail, wearing a small crown and a red cape with fur trim. It holds a basic poke ball, mouth closed, expressionless with a flat look.

A lone Pokemon creature, dressed up: a fur-trimmed red cape draped over it and a little crown perched on its head. Blue eyes, a tail curling behind, and it grips a basic poke ball. Its mouth stays shut and its face is blank, an even, expressionless stare.
服を着たポケモンを一匹。青い目に尻尾、王冠、ファー付きの赤マント。基本のモンスターボールを持って、口は閉じ、無表情で。
ポケモンを一匹、服着せた感じで頼める?青い目で尻尾あって、ちっちゃい王冠かぶって、ファーのついた赤マント。手にはノーマルのモンスターボール、口は閉じてて表情はぽけーっと無表情で。
黒髪ロング・青い目のちび女の子ひとり。獣耳と尻尾、肌に色付け、ノースリーブのボディスーツ。腰に手を当て、杖を持つ。黄色背景、髪飾り。
デフォルメ体型で黒髪ロングの女の子、瞳は青。頭には獣耳、後ろには尻尾、肌はちょっと色付き。袖なしのボディスーツを着て、片手を腰に当て、もう片手で杖を握っている。背景は黄色一色、髪飾りも忘れずに。
Chibi girl, solo, long black hair, blue eyes, animal ears and a tail, colored skin. Sleeveless bodysuit, one hand on her hip, holding a staff. Hair ornament, yellow background.

Could you draw a chibi girl on her own, long black hair, blue eyes, with animal ears and a tail and tinted skin? She's in a sleeveless bodysuit, one hand resting on her hip, the other holding a staff. Give her a hair ornament and a flat yellow background.
灰髪ロング・灰色の目の女の子ひとり、こっち見てる。黒い長袖ジャケットに黒手袋、パンスト、イヤリング。剣を携えて。
ひとりの女の子、灰色の長い髪に同じく灰の瞳でまっすぐこちらを見ている。黒い長袖のジャケットを羽織り、黒手袋をはめ、パンストにイヤリング。手には剣を一振り持たせて、凛とした立ち姿で。
Solo girl, long grey hair, grey eyes, looking at viewer. Black long-sleeved jacket, black gloves, pantyhose, earrings, a sword in hand.
I'm after a single girl with long grey hair and grey eyes, looking right at me. Put her in a black long-sleeved jacket with black gloves, pantyhose, earrings, and have her carrying a sword.
青髪ロングの女の子ひとり。公式別衣装で、白いドレスに帽子、髪は二本の三つ編み。髪飾りに花、リボンとボウを添えた別髪型で。
青い長髪の女の子をひとり、公式の別衣装で。白いドレスをまとい、帽子をかぶり、髪は普段と違うツインの三つ編みにアレンジ。髪には花の飾りとリボン、胸元にボウを結んで華やかに。
Solo blue-haired girl, long hair in twin braids as an alternate hairstyle. Official alternate costume: white dress, a hat, hair flower and ornament, ribbon and bow.
Let's do a lone girl with long blue hair done up in twin braids—an alternate look for her. She's in her official alt costume: white dress and a hat, with a flower in her hair, a ribbon and a bow.
Draw one blonde girl with long hair, an ahoge, green eyes and bangs between them. She wears a blue dress with armor and holds Excalibur from Fate, blood on the blade, mouth closed.

A solitary blonde, long hair with a single ahoge poking up, green eyes peering past the bangs between them. She wears a blue dress layered with armor and grips the holy sword Excalibur from Fate/stay night; blood streaks the steel while her lips stay sealed.
金髪ロング・アホ毛・緑目の女の子ひとり。青いドレスに鎧、Fateのエクスカリバーを構えて、刃に血、口は閉じて。
金髪ロングでアホ毛ぴょこ、緑の目の子をひとり描いて。前髪が目の間に落ちてて、青いドレスに鎧つけて、Fateのエクスカリバー握ってる感じ。刃にちょっと血、口は閉じたままで。

Draw two girls with blue eyes and blunt bangs, hairclips and ornaments. They wear frilly dresses with wide long sleeves and black gloves. One sticks out her tongue, and there's some food in the scene.

Two girls together, both blue-eyed with blunt bangs framed by hairclips and ornaments. Their frilled dresses have wide, long sleeves and they wear black gloves. A bit of food sits near them, and one girl playfully pokes out her tongue.
青い目・ぱっつん前髪の女の子ふたり。フリルのドレスに広い長袖、黒手袋、髪飾りとヘアクリップ。食べ物が少し、片方は舌を出して。
女の子ふたりで、どっちも青い目にぱっつん前髪、ヘアクリップと髪飾りつけてて。フリフリのドレスに袖広めの長袖、黒い手袋。近くに食べ物置いて、片方はべーって舌出してる感じで。
青髪短髪・青い目の女の子ひとり、こっち見て笑顔で口開けてる。前髪が目の間に。獣耳と尻尾、白い襟付きシャツにノースリーブのドレス、ボウ。
ひとりの女の子、短い青髪に青い瞳で、こちらを見ながら口を開けてにっこり。前髪が目の間に落ち、頭には獣耳、後ろに尻尾。白い襟付きシャツの上にノースリーブのドレスを重ね、ボウのアクセントを添えて。
Solo girl, short blue hair, blue eyes, animal ears and tail, looking at viewer with an open smile. White collared shirt under a sleeveless dress, a bow, bangs between her eyes.

Can you draw one girl with short blue hair and blue eyes, animal ears and a tail, grinning at the viewer with her mouth open? White collared shirt under a sleeveless dress, a bow, bangs falling between her eyes.
Draw a smiling blonde girl with blue eyes and twin drill twintails, a bow, earrings and a facial mark. She's looking at the viewer, with some fruit and a small animal beside her.

A cheerful blonde girl alone, blue-eyed, her hair styled into twin drills with a bow on top. She wears earrings and has a small mark on her face as she beams at the viewer. Set a piece of fruit and a little animal companion at her side.
金髪・青い目の女の子ひとり、笑顔でこっち見てる。ツインのドリル髪、ボウ、イヤリング、顔のマーク。果物と小動物を添えて。
金髪で青い目の子をひとり、にこっと笑ってこっち見てる感じで。髪はツインのドリルで上にボウ、イヤリングして顔にちょこっとマーク。横に果物と小動物置いといて。
緑髪・緑の目の女の子ひとり、こっち見てる。長袖の襟付きシャツに黒いボウタイ、ボタン、フリル、帽子。ハートを添えてサインも。
緑の髪に緑の瞳の女の子をひとり、まっすぐこちらを見て。長袖の襟付きシャツにボタンが並び、首元には黒いボウタイ、裾にはフリル、頭には帽子。ハートのモチーフをあしらい、隅に作者のサインを入れて。
Solo green-haired girl with green eyes, looking at viewer. Long-sleeved collared shirt with buttons, a black bow tied as a bowtie, frills, a hat. A heart motif and a signature.

I'd like a single girl with green hair and green eyes facing me. Long-sleeved collared shirt with buttons and frills, a black bow at the collar like a bowtie, a hat on top. Add a heart somewhere and a little signature.

Draw one girl with long hair, blue eyes and bangs between them, animal ears, looking at the viewer. She wears a serafuku school uniform with puffy long sleeves under a dress, a hat, jewelry, sidelocks and a flower.

A lone girl with long hair and blue eyes, bangs parted between them, animal ears atop her head, meeting the viewer's gaze. She wears a sailor-style serafuku with puffy long sleeves layered like a dress, a hat, some jewelry, soft sidelocks and a single flower.
ロング・青い目・獣耳の女の子ひとり、こっち見てる。セーラー服にパフ長袖のドレス、帽子、宝飾品、サイドの髪、花。
髪の長い子をひとり、青い目で前髪が目の間、頭に獣耳ついててこっち見てる感じで。セーラー服っぽい制服にパフスリーブの長袖ドレス、帽子かぶってアクセつけて、サイドの髪に花さして。
茶髪ロング・アクア色の目の女の子ひとり。青いシャツにセーター、ベルト付きパンツに靴。片手を腰に、カップを持って、影と睫毛を描き込んで。
茶色の長い髪、水色がかった瞳の女の子をひとり。青いシャツにセーターを重ね、ベルトを通したパンツに靴。片手を腰に当て、もう片手にカップを持っている。睫毛を丁寧に、足元に落ちる影もしっかりと。
Solo girl, long brown hair, aqua eyes, eyelashes drawn in. Blue shirt with a sweater, belted pants, shoes, one hand on her hip, holding a cup, a cast shadow.

Could you draw a single girl with long brown hair and aqua eyes? Blue shirt, a sweater over it, belted pants and shoes. One hand on her hip, holding a cup, with detailed lashes and a shadow under her.
茶髪ロング・多色の髪の女の子ひとり、こっち見てる。獣耳と尻尾、前髪が目の間に、三つ編みとサイドの髪、カチューシャ。手袋とドレス、胸は普通サイズで。
ひとりの女の子、茶色ベースに色の混ざった長髪で、こちらを見つめている。頭には獣耳、後ろに尻尾、前髪は目の間に落ち、三つ編みとサイドの髪にカチューシャ。手袋をはめてドレスをまとい、胸はほどよい大きさで描いて。
Solo girl, long multicolored brown hair, animal ears and tail, bangs between her eyes, looking at viewer. Braid and sidelocks, a hairband, gloves, a dress, medium bust.

I'd like one girl with long brown hair shot through with other colors, animal ears and a tail, looking my way. Bangs between her eyes, a braid, sidelocks and a hairband, gloves and a dress, a medium bust.

Draw two girls looking at the viewer, both short hair, one with twintails. One has blue hair, the other pink with purple eyes. Short-sleeved shirts and aprons, socks and shoes, hair ornaments, with some English text.

Two girls facing the viewer, short hair on both, one wearing twintails. The blue-haired one stands beside her pink-haired friend with purple eyes. They wear short-sleeved shirts under aprons, with socks and shoes, hair ornaments in place, and a line of English text in the frame.
短髪の女の子ふたり、こっち見てる。片方ツインテで青髪、もう片方はピンク髪に紫の目。半袖シャツとエプロン、靴下に靴、髪飾り、英語のテキストも。
女子ふたりがこっち見てる絵にして。どっちもショートで、片方はツインテの青髪、もう片方はピンク髪に紫の目。半袖シャツにエプロン、靴下と靴はいて、髪飾りつけて。英語の文字もどっかに入れといて。

Draw a blonde girl with animal ears and a tail, yellow eyes, bangs between them, looking at the viewer. She wears a hooded white dress with a belt and a cape, sidelocks framing her face, plus a necklace.

A lone blonde girl with animal ears and a tail, yellow-eyed, bangs falling between them as she meets the viewer's gaze. Her white dress carries a hood and a belt, a cape over her shoulders, sidelocks at her cheeks, and a necklace at her throat.
金髪・黄色い目・獣耳と尻尾の女の子ひとり、こっち見てる。フード付きの白いドレスにベルト、マント、サイドの髪、ネックレス。
金髪で黄色い目、獣耳と尻尾の子をひとり、こっち見てる感じで。前髪が目の間に落ちてて、フード付きの白ワンピにベルト締めて、マント羽織って。サイドの髪とネックレスも添えてね。
尖った耳の男子ひとり、こっち見てる。黒地に映える黄色く光る目、白シャツにベスト、黒手袋、帽子、マスク。背景は黒。
ひとりの男の子、尖った耳をして黒い背景の中に立つ。瞳は黄色く光り、こちらを見据えている。白いシャツの上にベストを重ね、黒手袋をはめ、帽子をかぶってマスクで口元を覆っている。
Solo boy with pointy ears, looking at viewer, glowing yellow eyes on a black background. White shirt, a vest, black gloves, a hat, and a mask.
Give me a single guy with pointy ears staring out, his eyes glowing yellow against a pitch-black background. White shirt under a vest, black gloves, a hat, and a mask over his face.

Draw a group of two girls and one boy. The girls have animal ears and bare shoulders, one with very long white hair and a braid, both wearing dresses. Blonde and white hair, green eyes, sidelocks, earrings and jewelry.

A trio: two girls and a boy together. The girls wear dresses that bare their shoulders, animal ears atop their heads—one has very long white hair pulled into a braid, the other is blonde. Green eyes, soft sidelocks, earrings and other jewelry complete them.
女の子ふたりと男子ひとり。獣耳に肩出し、片方は超ロングの白髪で三つ編み、もう片方は金髪。ドレス、緑の目、サイドの髪、イヤリング。
女子ふたりと男子ひとりのグループで頼める?女の子は獣耳で肩出しのドレス、片方はめっちゃ長い白髪を三つ編みに、もう片方は金髪。緑の目にサイドの髪、イヤリングつけて。

Draw a barefoot girl with long hair and a crown, wings on her back, looking at the viewer with a big grin and squinted eyes. Blonde and grey hair, purple eyes, parted bangs, a crop top and skirt, a box nearby. Add a date and twitter handle.

A long-haired girl, barefoot, a little crown on her head and wings spread behind her. Her hair mixes blonde and grey, eyes purple under parted bangs, and she beams with eyes scrunched shut in delight. She wears a crop top and skirt, a box set beside her; mark a date and a twitter username in the corner.
ロングヘア・裸足の女の子、王冠と翼。金髪と灰髪、紫の目、中分け前髪。クロップトップにスカート、満面の笑みで目はぎゅっと。箱、日付、twitter名も。
長髪で裸足の子を描いて、頭に小さい王冠で背中に翼。金と灰の混じった髪に紫の目、前髪は中分け。へそ出しのクロップトップにスカートで、にぱっと笑って目はぎゅーって閉じてる。横に箱と日付、twitterのIDも添えて。
複数の女の子が屋外に。大きな胸、襟付きシャツに半袖、スカート、帽子、ボウとリボン、フリル。角や翼、尖った耳もあるコマ割りのコミック風で。
屋外を舞台に女の子が複数。胸の大きな子たちが襟付きの半袖シャツとスカートをまとい、帽子にボウとリボン、裾にフリル。中には角や翼を生やし尖った耳の子も。全体はコマ割りのコミック形式で描いて。
Multiple girls outdoors in a comic panel layout. Large breasts, collared short-sleeved shirts, skirts, hats, bows and ribbons, frills. Some have horns, wings and pointy ears.

Let's do several girls outdoors, laid out like a comic with panels. Busty figures in collared short-sleeved shirts and skirts, hats on, bows and ribbons with frills—and give a few of them horns, wings, and pointy ears.
茶髪ロングの女の子ふたり、お互いを見てる。学校制服にセーラー襟、髪飾りとヘアクリップ、リボン。片方は緑の目、もう片方は紫の目、髪に花。
茶色い長髪の女の子がふたり、互いに視線を交わしている。どちらも学校の制服にセーラー襟、髪には飾りとヘアクリップ、リボンを添えて。片方は緑の瞳、もう片方は紫の瞳で、髪に小さな花を挿して。

Two girls with long brown hair, looking at each other. School uniforms with sailor collars, hair ornaments and hairclips, ribbons. One has green eyes, the other purple, with a flower in the hair; one wears medium-length hair.

Two brown-haired girls glancing at one another. Both in school uniforms with sailor collars, hair ornaments, clips and ribbons. One girl's eyes are green, the other's purple, a flower tucked into her hair.
Draw one girl standing with long hair in a ponytail, a long-sleeved dress, a sash and a bow. She blushes and smiles with her mouth open, a small heart, a dot nose. Keep it in a rough sketch style.
